Our keeper clues were single words that scored little, and we left snow unrevealed, so next time the keeper should give two or more clues with a shared link.

A single-word clue wastes tempo, so the keeper should give two or more clues that share a link. Sea was a useful two-word clue that hit reef, one of our words. Categorical links like fruit also worked well, since the fruit-linked two landed as a bonus. I'll keep the retro concise.
